extraction.notes: AVB reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Q3 2025 column used (first column). Casualty loss on real estate is shown as a dash for Q3 2025 (zero), so it is omitted. Executive transition compensation costs is a dash for Q3 2025 (zero), so it is omitted. Diluted shares printed as 143,535,401 and converted to thousands (143,535.401). Recomputed per-share checks: 431,969 / 143,535.401 = 3.01 FFO; 394,193 / 143,535.401 = 2.75 Core FFO. Subtotals verified arithmetically. The same reconciliation appears again on printed page 22 (seq 38); page seq 11 was used. Categories: SIP loan reserve, advocacy contributions, other real estate activity (gains on non-operating real estate), and income tax benefit were classified as 'other' because no listed category fits. Unconsolidated entity gains (net unrealized gains on property technology investments) were classified as investment_gain_loss.
